name: Big number with ring
technique: A full-width display number counts up (1.4 s, power3.out, lands and holds) while a progress ring draws round it; the unit pops in the accent and a label sharpens below. Only for numbers with a source (features.json or real data).

source.label: Source line (keep claims honest)
source.default: sq · en · de · it · es · pl · ru · fr

notes: Never put user, download or listing counts here without a real data source (features.json → neverClaim).
